title: Tenant Control Plane Contract
summary: Project tenant-isolated administration under user, capability and plan intersection; cross-tenant access remains denied.

criteria: The tenant control plane is the surface on which a SaaS customer administers its own business, and every request on it is bound to exactly one trusted TenantContext that the plane may never widen.
Effective authority is an intersection over user ∩ capability ∩ plan; effective authority is an intersection rather than a union, so no leg can grant what another leg withholds.
A missing, unknown or malformed leg resolves to deny rather than being skipped, which keeps the plane default-deny under partial context.
A context-absent request returns zero rows instead of an unscoped result set, so an unbound query can never leak a neighbouring tenant's data.
cross-tenant read and write are denied and the denial reason discloses nothing about the neighbouring tenant, not even whether the resource exists.
The plane is a projection and is not a security boundary by itself: every decision is still evaluated by the PDP, and control-plane-taxonomy-contract owns the plane vocabulary this contract consumes.
plan entitlement is consumed, not owned: the plane reads an entitlement input and never becomes a plan or billing engine.

risks.desc: A tenant administration surface that resolves an absent or forged context to an unscoped query would expose one customer's records to another, which is the single most damaging failure a SaaS control plane can have.
risks.mitigation: Bind every request to one TenantContext, return zero rows when the context is absent and prove cross-tenant refusal with a dedicated negative for both read and write.

risks.desc: Treating the intersection as a union, or skipping an unavailable leg, would silently promote a partially authorized user to full tenant administration.
risks.mitigation: Define the effective set as a narrowing intersection and resolve any missing, unknown or malformed leg to deny, with a negative per omitted leg.

risks.desc: A tenant administrator could reach developer-plane structural mutation or an ops-plane hosting action if the plane boundary were enforced only by capability configuration.
risks.mitigation: Refuse both by plane before any capability check so that no permission grant can widen the plane, and keep the taxonomy vocabulary owned by control-plane-taxonomy-contract.

risks.desc: Consuming a plan entitlement could drift into owning plan definition, pricing or billing inside the tenant plane and duplicate an authority that lives elsewhere.
risks.mitigation: State that plan entitlement is consumed, not owned, keep the entitlement input read-only on this plane and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: The tenant control plane sağlar a customer-facing administration surface for one tenant only, and every entry point on it is bound to exactly one trusted TenantContext.

Girdi is an authenticated actor plus a TenantContext, a capability set and a consumed plan entitlement; çıktı is an allow or deny decision carrying the plane, the tenant and the deciding policy reference.
effective authority is an intersection of user ∩ capability ∩ plan, and a missing, unknown or malformed leg resolves to deny rather than being skipped.
A context-absent request returns zero rows instead of an unscoped result set, and cross-tenant read and write stay denied under every plane state.
Kapsam sınırı gereği panel implementation, surface schema, identity/authentication lifecycle, policy authoring and storage and ECA/ruleset automation all stay outside.

Kapsa: one-tenant administration surface, trusted TenantContext binding, the user ∩ capability ∩ plan intersection, deny on a missing leg, zero rows when context is absent. Exclude panel implementation, surface schema, identity lifecycle, policy authoring and ECA automation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Tenant izolasyon is the primary control: erişim is bound to one TenantContext, and a cross-tenant read or write is denied rather than rescoped.
The denial reason discloses nothing about the neighbouring tenant, so an attacker cannot use deny messages to enumerate resources that belong to someone else.
The plane stays default-deny: an action with no matching capability is refused, and a missing, unknown or malformed leg resolves to deny instead of being skipped.

The plane is not a security boundary on its own; the PDP remains the deciding authority and every administrative decision leaves an append-only denetim izi carrying tenant, actor, action and policy reference.
An agent tool call raised on this plane inherits the invoking user's intersection and can never exceed it, so delegation cannot become privilege escalation.
security.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/security: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
security.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract security kapsamı. Kapsa: one-tenant binding and cross-tenant denial, non-disclosing denial reasons, default-deny under partial context, PDP as decider with append-only audit, capped agent delegation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one tipli intersection katman so the user, capability and plan legs cannot develop divergent evaluation rules across entry points.
Intersection evaluation stays a pure function with low karmaşıklık, testable without a tenant fixture, and the plane check stays separate from the capability check.
Ölü kod and speculative per-tenant branches are refused, the short-code bütçe is respected, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: En az ayrıcalık applies per tenant: a plane credential grants no read into another tenant's data and cannot be widened by configuration alone.
The administrative yüzey stays kapalı: the accepted action set is an allowlist rather than whatever a caller requests, and an unknown action is refused.
A tenant-scoped rate-limit bounds administrative calls, so one noisy tenant cannot exhaust shared capacity for the others.
Plane-crossing attempts toward developer or ops actions are refused before any capability check, so a misconfigured grant never becomes an escalation path.
securityOptimization.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: per-tenant least privilege, closed allowlisted action surface, tenant-scoped rate limits, plane-first refusal of cross-plane actions. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for the intersection evaluation on the administrative path and a separate budget for a tenant-scoped list query; no measurement is claimed here.
The capability and plan legs are read through a bounded önbellek keyed by tenant and invalidated on entitlement change, so the intersection is not recomputed from scratch per row.
Tenant-scoped listing must avoid N+1 access: the tenant predicate is applied in the query rather than filtered after fetch.
performance.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budgets for intersection evaluation and tenant-scoped listing, tenant-keyed cache with entitlement invalidation, N+1 avoidance through in-query tenant predicates. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client administering a tenant carries the same TenantContext binding as the web surface; a cihaz may not widen the plane or carry a second tenant in one session.
An offline mobile client shows the last synchronized administrative state as stale and refuses to queue a plane-crossing action for later replay.
No mobile-only administrative capability is introduced here; rendering the plane stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: identical TenantContext binding on mobile, no second tenant per session, stale offline display without queued plane-crossing actions. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future tenant administration surface must convey a denied action and its reason through text rather than colour alone, at the WCAG AAA kontrast threshold with a visible odak ring.
A denial must be announced through an aria live region naming the action and the plane, so a klavye-only operator learns the outcome without a visual cue.
This contract defines plane semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: non-colour-only denial conveyance at AAA contrast, announced denials through live regions, keyboard-first operation, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; the hosting topology of any tenant panel and its container dağıtım remain human-developer work behind ops-plane authority.
Changing a capability or plan mapping is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a redeploy; rollback returns to the previous mapping without touching tenant data.
Reverting this plane shard changes the planning contract and the projections derived from it, never a live tenant record, so runtimeDataImpact stays none and NO-GO remains in force.
deployment.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, hosting owned by the ops plane, data-level mapping changes without redeploy, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: An administrative decision olay may be published for audit and downstream reaction, but this plane never executes a business action on the tenant's behalf.
A reaction chain raised from a plane olay stops at maxChainDepth 6, so an administrative burst cannot cascade without bound.
Re-delivering the same administrative olay must be idempotent, and changing a capability or plan mapping always requires an explicit onay; ECA/ruleset automation itself stays outside this contract.
eca.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: audit events without acting for the tenant, depth-bounded reaction chains, idempotent replay and approval-gated mapping changes, excluded ruleset automation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay yasak.
An agent tool call raised on this plane can never exceed the invoking user's intersection, and widening a tenant capability or plan mapping requires insan onayı with a step-up review.

Any tenant-supplied payload reaching the lane as sub_prompt is güvenilmez, the kill-switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 sınır or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, agent calls capped by the caller's intersection, step-up for capability or plan widening, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases prove a tenant administrator acting inside its own TenantContext with all three legs present succeeds, as birim and entegrasyon matrices.
Planned negatif cases prove tenant A reading or writing a tenant B resource is denied and that the denial reason discloses nothing about the neighbouring tenant.
Planned negatif cases prove a context-absent request returns zero rows, and that omitting the capability leg or the plan leg still resolves to deny.
Planned negatif cases prove developer-plane structural mutation is excluded and ops-plane hosting action is excluded by plane before any capability check.
Plane results are recordable only from a human-approved run that truly executed, so the planned matrices here are never counted as passing tests.
testing.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: in-context positives, cross-tenant and non-disclosing denial negatives, context-absent zero-row negatives, missing-leg negatives, plane-first exclusion negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is the defining axis: binding every request to one TenantContext and denying cross-tenant access by construction is what keeps one customer out of another's records.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by making the plane exclusion structural, so developer-plane structural mutation and ops-plane hosting action cannot be re-enabled by a permission grant.
OWASP A09 security logging and monitoring failures is modeled by an append-only denetim izi on every allow and deny, carrying tenant, actor, action and policy reference.
Girdi doğrulama applies to the context itself: a tenant identifier supplied by the caller is validated against the trusted TenantContext and never trusted as provided.
owasp.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 via one-context binding and cross-tenant denial, A04 via structural plane exclusion, A09 via append-only audit, caller-supplied tenant identifier validation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-control-planes with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-control-planes] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so an administrative decision touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; it is announced as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor control-plane-taxonomy-contract ends 2028-06-09, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.

Bağımlılık yönü stays exactly control-plane-taxonomy-contract and agent-tool-execution-contract, and the parent-only k-agent-runtime, k-tenancy and adr-0015 edges and the parent related list are not inherited.
Scope stays inside the plane sözleşme: panel implementation, surface schema, identity/authentication lifecycle, policy authoring and storage and ECA/ruleset automation all stay outside.
integration.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-control-planes to the same provider, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir tenant administration through this contract's capability surface and may not reach a doğrudan tablo for tenant-scoped records.
A consumer must carry the TenantContext with every derived read and write, so a cached or aggregated view cannot outlive the context that authorized it.
Owning the plan or entitlement definition belongs elsewhere: plan entitlement is consumed, not owned, and this sözleşme only reads it as one intersection leg.
moduleUsage.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: contract-mediated administration without direct table reads, TenantContext carried into derived reads and writes, consumed rather than owned plan entitlement. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: Tenant administration records identify named people and therefore carry PII directly, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
The audit trail of allow and deny decisions has its own saklama süresi, separate from the tenant business data it describes, because a deleted record must still leave a defensible decision history.
Administrative decisions are retained append-only so a historical authority state stays explainable, and stored records evolve by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: direct PII in administration records with KVKK/GDPR classification and DSAR path, a separate audit retention window, append-only decision history and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrik set includes intersection evaluation latency, deny rate by leg, cross-tenant refusal counts and context-absent request counts on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the tenant identifier class, the plane and the deciding policy reference; actor names and record contents are redacted and never become metric labels.

Alarm coverage includes a cross-tenant refusal spike, a context-absent surge suggesting a broken caller and an unusual deny-by-plan rate after an entitlement change; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: intersection latency and deny-by-leg SLIs, redacted tenant-scoped traces, cross-tenant and context-absent alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The dominant failure mode is an unavailable capability or plan source; the plane resolves the missing leg to deny and degrades to read-only rather than assuming prior authority.
Administrative writes are idempotent by construction: replaying the same decision for the same request key yields the same stored state, so a retry with bounded backoff cannot double-apply a grant.
A repeatedly failing administrative action is routed to a dead-letter path for human review rather than blocking the tenant's queue, and a circuit breaker protects the shared decision path.
reliability.notes: tenant-control-plane-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Tenant Control Plane Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: deny-on-missing-leg degradation, idempotent administrative writes with bounded retry, dead-letter routing without head-of-line blocking and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
